scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @jarvis/api" "npm run dev -w @jarvis/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jarvis/api && npm run build -w @jarvis/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @jarvis/api && npm run typecheck -w @jarvis/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @jarvis/api && node --import tsx --test apps/api/test/*.test.mjs
